head_commit.message:
Honor Daybreak settings in TUI continuations and background tasks (#49859)

## Why

Cyber-policy refusal guidance did not distinguish whether Daybreak was on or off, and policy continuations and background task turns omitted `cyberAccessProgram`.

## What changed

- Show refusal guidance for the current Daybreak setting and offer eligible users an “Enable Daybreak” picker for their next request. Persist the selection without automatically retrying the refused request, and suppress the picker during history replay and when viewing parent-owned threads.
- Select and validate the cyber access program for policy continuations and background task turns using account eligibility, model support, and the thread's Daybreak setting.
- Resolve new background threads' Daybreak defaults from effective configuration unless launch flags or a selected profile explicitly override them. Use the target thread's saved setting for follow-up messages.

## Testing

Add unit, snapshot, and request-recording coverage for refusal guidance, picker behavior, continuation access programs, and background tasks retaining Daybreak after configuration changes.

Add protocol tests for advertised-program selection and exec integration tests for account and provider restrictions, saved choices, ephemeral forks, and invocation-only overrides.
